title: PissInTheWind 16x
description: a joji's new album overlay that adds a themed environment
body:
![PissInTheWind 16x](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5aacebe4173986c4234713e27bf156975aac42fc.png)

**Adds sky enderpearl, moon, and sun. Based on Joji's latest album release, "Piss In The Wind"**

**I'm going to be updating it, so make sure to follow the project!**

- Btw you can combine it with Blod [16x] texture pack for a perfect match
- https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/blod
